name: Bhakti Gems & Jewellery Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Bhakti Gems & Gems Jewellery Ltd trades precious metals and 
jewellery[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BGGJL is an integrated manufacturer and wholesaler of branded jewellery and ornaments, based in Ahmedabad. Its product range includes gold jewellery, with or without precious and semi-precious stones, catering to traditional, modern, and Indo-Western tastes. The company’s traditional pieces often feature Kundan work, gemstones, American diamonds, or plain gold designs.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 33.3 to 25.9 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -29.9%
Company has a low return on equity of 3.78% over last 3 years.
